welcome.title: Welcome to Wai Action
welcome.subtitle: A tool to care for Aotearoa’s waters.
welcome.body: By using less water, keeping pollutants out of drains, and having a say in decisions, we can improve the health of our water and our people.

why.title: Why this app exists
why.body: Aotearoa’s water systems are under pressure from ageing infrastructure, population growth, climate change and funding gaps. These affect drinking water safety, wastewater and stormwater that flows into our rivers and seas.

bullets.rest: Water is a taonga; iwi and hapū must have meaningful input into decisions.
Protect the life force of water for future generations.
Uphold people’s mana and include all cultures.

actions.title: Wai actions
actions.intro: Pick three small actions: one for water use, one for pollutants, one for participation. Together, these small steps add up to big change for our water and our people.

modules.title: Use less water
modules.subtitle: Simple ways to reduce your water use.
modules.body: Reducing household water use eases pressure on treatment plants and pipes.

cards.rest: A full load uses the same ~13 L as a half one. The extra dishes ride free.
A dripping tap? Repair it promptly.

modules.title: Keep pollutants out
modules.subtitle: Drains only for rain.
modules.body: Most stormwater is untreated before reaching streams and harbours.

cards.rest: No paint, oil or cleaners to stormwater.
Not on concrete that drains to streams.

modules.title: Get involved
modules.subtitle: Your voice, your impact.
modules.body: You can influence council and community decisions about water through submissions, meetings and local projects.

cards.rest: On Long-Term Plans and water strategies.
